description: This file contains server setup and handling code for a test server, including classes for error handling, request handling, server management, and server startup routines.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Base exception class for module-specific errors.

classes.name: OptionError
classes.description: Error class for invalid command line options.

classes.name: FileMultiplexer
classes.description: Handles writing to two file descriptors simultaneously.

classes.name: ClientRestrictingServerMixIn
classes.description: Mix-in class to restrict server connections to a specific IP.

classes.name: BrokenPipeHandlerMixIn
classes.description: Mix-in class to handle broken pipe and connection reset errors gracefully.

classes.name: StoppableHTTPServer
classes.description: HTTP server subclass that can be stopped cleanly.

classes.name: BasePageHandler
classes.description: HTTP request handler with support for multiple request types and custom handlers.

classes.name: TestServerRunner
classes.description: Class to run and manage the lifecycle of the test server, including options and startup notification.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Outputs debug messages to standard error.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes text to the associated file descriptors.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the output buffers.

methods.name: verify_request
methods.description: Verifies incoming request IP addresses.

methods.name: handle_error
methods.description: Handles socket errors during server operation.

methods.name: serve_forever
methods.description: Runs the server loop until stopped.

methods.name: MultiplexerHack
methods.description: Creates a FileMultiplexer or returns log_fd directly if std_fd is invalid.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes server and request handler classes.

methods.name: log_request
methods.description: Overrides default to disable request logging.

methods.name: _ShouldHandleRequest
methods.description: Determines if a request path matches a handler.

methods.name: do_CONNECT
methods.description: Handles CONNECT HTTP method.

methods.name: do_GET
methods.description: Handles GET HTTP method.

methods.name: do_HEAD
methods.description: Handles HEAD HTTP method.

methods.name: do_POST
methods.description: Handles POST HTTP method.

methods.name: do_PUT
methods.description: Handles PUT HTTP method.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point to run the server, parse options, and start serving.

methods.name: create_server
methods.description: Abstract method to create server instance, to be overridden.

methods.name: run_server
methods.description: Starts the server loop and handles shutdown.

methods.name: add_options
methods.description: Defines command-line options for server configuration.

methods.name: _notify_startup_complete
methods.description: Sends startup completion message and server data to parent process.
